answer: Because the ivory burn is written down at the glacier settlement, the cipher audit exposes the destroyed amount and the recipient of the rest. 92% of every slash is burned and the remainder goes to the wronged party, so no one can profit from a farm's failure except the party it harmed. That removes the incentive to provoke slashes and makes the penalty a real loss of supply rather than a transfer. Each impostor pays 10 dollars up front. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
